reviews.comment: 2 exams worth 20%, deceptively difficult even with a review session and cheat sheets, they determine your grade in the class. Labs aren't too bad, its all Gemini. Homeworks are easy and there are only like 5 in the semester. Nowka himself talks super slow and its hard to pay attention, but if you want to earn the grade you have to listen to him
his lectures are pretty straightforward but you have to take notes over what he says too because that will show up on exam. his personality can be kinda blunt almost scary...
Pretty decent prof and nice guy though him and the TA grade rather harshly.

Lectures are beyond boring, nobody comes to class and when they do he kicks them out for not doing the reading before beware. Does not respond to a single email ever throughout the whole semester, so you'll have to email TA about questions or ask in class. Exam is so bad even with cheat sheet, and he gives bad exam reviews. Just a rude prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Nowka can be rather tough on you if he doesn't understand what you're doing, and considering the wide range of topics in the class, that tends to happen quite a bit. However, getting past that, he doesn't mince words and genuinely wishes for you to succeed, even if that comes through in a rather blunt manner.
Very concise professor. He made me enjoy a subject I originally hated. Would recommend!

I didn't like this class, bc the labs are pretty much all copy paste and self teach, but looking back on it there's a lot of interesting content. If you pay attention in lecture and try to be interested in the stuff then you'll do well, but not caring about the class as many did (bc it's kinda unrelated to ECEN) will hurt you.
Fun prof who really cares about teaching ML. Very reasonable, fair exams. I actually ended up learning a lot, would recommend!

ECEN 250: Found his lectures to be interesting. Homework is not too bad as most of the information you need is in his lecture slides. Labs were pretty time-consuming (mostly Python coding), but the lab graders were pretty lenient. Exams are not bad. You get a cheat sheet, so make sure to take notes on all the topics in the review slides to prepare.

ECEN-250:
The class is interesting and useful and he does a good job explaining the theory behind the machine learning, but he doesn't show how to do the code, and the labs/final project are pretty difficult and make up a large chunk of your grade.

Nowka is really good when it comes to feedback on your project, he will not hesitate to point out issues with your presentations. His advice during lab is good as it doesn't spoonfeed you a solution to an issue you might be having, he sort of guides you in the direction towards the line of thought you need to figure things out on your own.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Nowka values being able to clearly present a functional product with an easy-to-understand motivation, and being able to prove with data that it works well. Such projects are graded generously.

If you were assigned a project that makes any of the above difficult, you will be graded harshly. Complex projects should look for a different professor.

ECEN 214: Very good at explaining concepts, and is very patient if you ask questions. He's got a lot of industry experience working at IBM, and talks about the work that he's done in industry. His test are very fair, so long as you put in the work. Slides are very clear and good study material. He gives you all the resources to be successful!

For ECEN 214: Kevin Nowka is a great and accessible professor. Lectures aren't mandatory except for the weekly quiz, but I learned the most from actively following along with the examples he worked. His tests and quizzes are super fair. The homework can be super time consuming and is sometimes not relevant, but that is the only issue I had.

Professor Nowka is very knowledgeable and will help you if don't completely understand the topics. You'll be fine if you engage in his lectures and show up to class. The homeworks and quizzes can be difficult, but he makes up for them by making the tests easy.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: ECEN 214: he makes the quizzes and tests very fairly, if you know the content you will do extremely well on them

He definitely doesn't care about his class nor students. He skips a lot of works on his slides or sometimes just drop the answer with a few explanations. However, if you visit his office hours, he teaches students like a perfect private tutor that will make you understand in 10 seconds. Not a perfect professor but also doable with his exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Horrible prof that obviously does not care about teaching their student this course. Gives quizzes with 10+ questions and expects you to complete them within 7 minutes...

**Had him in ECEN 289. Great class and experience. He taught us stuff in a straight to the point way and the HWs were great as they were not burdensome and were straight to the point. Had a great experience and I heavily recommend you pick him.

404 is really based on your project not the prof. But Nowka can be kinda a hard grader. I haven't seen him give a 100 to anyone in the class. He is big on students having great presentation skills. Sometimes he's quick to respond to an email.
